record.question: The highest fine imposed in BNS is up to Rs.___ lakhs.
record.explanation: The BNS provides for fines of up to Rs. 10 lakhs in its highest capped-fine provisions, so the correct choice is 10. Some serious offences prescribe a fine of at least Rs. 10 lakhs rather than stating an upper limit.
